requirements.statement: After both atomic accesses complete without a precise Data Abort, SWP writes the original aligned memory word rotated right by eight times address[1:0], and SWPB writes the zero-extended selected byte, to Rd.

source_refs.locator: §A4.1.108 SWP operation, alignment, and Data Abort; §A4.1.109 SWPB

requirements.statement: A precise abort of the SWP/SWPB read cancels the following store, while an abort of either access suppresses the Rd update and requests Data Abort entry.

source_refs.locator: §A4.1.108 SWP Data Abort; §A4.1.109 SWPB Data Abort
